summary: Frontend E2E validation of the P1 HYBRID Moderator role (Rebel Trade Network). All 6 requested scenarios PASS. Admin can promote a verified user to moderator via the Users panel dropdown (toggle-moderator-<id>) with a 'Role updated to moderator' toast + shield badge shown on the row. The Make Moderator button is disabled for unverified users. Moderator sees only nav-moderation (no nav-admin), opens the Moderation Queue (moderation-dashboard + admin-reports-panel present), and pending reports expose Resolve/Dismiss/Escalate actions; the escalated filter (reports-filter-escalated) shows the escalated report with the ESCALATED BY MOD TESTER badge. Moderator can delete another user's barter post via the post menu (post-menu-delete-<id>). Regular verified user (after demote) has no nav-admin, no nav-moderation, and no Delete Post option on other users' posts (only Report Post/Block User).

frontend: TEST1: Admin -> Admin Dashboard -> user-actions-<verified_id> -> toggle-moderator-<id> = 'Make Moderator' enabled; click yields 'Role updated to moderator' toast and shield/moderator badge on the row
TEST2: For unverified user (Test Matcher) toggle-moderator-<id> button is present but disabled=True (correct gating)
TEST3: mod@homesteadhub.com login -> nav-moderation renders (2 copies: mobile+desktop), nav-admin absent (0). Clicking nav-moderation shows moderation-dashboard + admin-reports-panel

TEST4: Moderation queue shows Pending/Escalated/Resolved/Dismissed/All filter tabs. Existing pending report already escalated (ESCALATED BY MOD TESTER badge). Escalated filter (reports-filter-escalated) shows 1 escalated report with report-escalated-<id> badge. Resolve (report-resolve-<id>) and Dismiss (report-dismiss-<id>) buttons render on pending items.

TEST5: As moderator on Barter Feed, opening post-menu-btn-<id> on another user's post shows Delete Post option (post-menu-delete-<id>) visible=True. Clicking it deletes the post (post-menu no longer in DOM after action).

TEST6: verified@homesteadhub.com (role=user after demote) -> nav-admin=0, nav-moderation=0. On barter feed, opening post-menu on other users' posts shows only View Profile / Propose Trade / Send Message / Report Post / Block User — NO Delete Post option (has_delete=False).

critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar renders nav items twice (mobile drawer + desktop) so [data-testid="nav-moderation"] and [data-testid="nav-admin"] return 2 elements. This was flagged in prior iterations for nav-security/nav-admin as well. Consider suffixing testids with -mobile/-desktop or using a single portalized nav to reduce duplication and make automation more deterministic.

Delete flow on PostMenu uses window.confirm (native dialog) rather than a styled Confirm modal, inconsistent with the rest of the app's dark themed UI (previously flagged in iteration_27). Not blocking but a UX polish item.

PostCard passes isAdmin={user?.role === 'admin' || user?.role === 'moderator'} — prop is now semantically misnamed (should be isStaff or canModerate). Rename would improve readability and prevent future misuse.

Admin Users panel row heights are large and the 'Make Moderator' item in dropdown looks disabled purely by style (icon greyed); ensure the disabled state has an accessible tooltip explaining 'User must be verified first' — currently no tooltip / aria-label was observed on the disabled item.

ReportsPanel: when a pending report is already escalated it still shows the Pending badge alongside 'Escalated by ...' badge. Consider moving escalated reports out of Pending count so counts don't overlap between Pending(1) and Escalated(1) referring to the same row.

moderation.py escalate: the only pending seeded report was already escalated by earlier backend tests, so fresh escalate could not be re-verified from UI in this run. The escalated badge + escalated filter listing confirm the FE wiring is functional.

Route architecture (/app/frontend/src/App.js) still uses a single `/` route with tab state instead of URL-driven routes for /admin and /moderation. Deep-linking, browser back button, and share-a-link flows won't work for the admin/moderation dashboards. Not a bug but a UX limitation.
seed_data_creation: During TEST1 the Verified Tester (6a47eab1865b27453ef5ba93) was promoted to moderator then demoted back to user. During TEST5 one barter post (id 69c8256c402b1a85517c6ba2) was DELETED by the moderator account — this is a real, non-restored deletion. If the seed post is needed, it will need to be re-seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar duplicates data-testids across mobile/desktop — always iterate query_selector_all + is_visible() rather than .first for nav-* selectors. Post menu trigger is data-testid=post-menu-btn-<id> (NOT post-menu-<id>). Delete option testid is post-menu-delete-<id>. The single seeded pending report is already escalated so a fresh escalate cannot be re-tested from UI unless a new report is created (submit one from any user's UI or via /api/moderation/report). Verified Tester is currently role=user (demoted at end of TEST6-prep).
rca of the issue: N/A - Moderator role feature works end-to-end on the frontend as designed.
